t: You're at Courtfield Gardens, a garden square in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. The composer Basil Harwood died here in 1949. He was an organist in the English church music tradition, and his anthem O How Glorious Is the Kingdom and his Service in A flat are still sung in English churches. He also wrote hymn tunes, including Luckington and Thornbury, which many congregations know, even if they don't know his name.
